notificationCenter.title: Notification center
notificationCenter.selectForDetails: Select a notification to view details.
notificationCenter.slowMeaning: The query exceeded the application's slow-operation threshold. This is not necessarily an error; the query or server took longer than expected.
notificationCenter.slowCause: A large result set, missing index, full scan, lock wait, network latency, or high server load can cause this.
notificationCenter.slowAction: Review the SQL and duration; if needed, check EXPLAIN/Execution Plan, indexes, locks, and the Process Center for the same time window.
notificationCenter.storageMeaning: Coreor could not refresh database or table storage metrics from the server.
notificationCenter.storageCause: Metadata permissions, engine/version differences, a missing object, or an SQL error returned by the driver may be responsible.
notificationCenter.storageAction: Review the error code and technical details. Refresh the catalog and retry; if access was denied, verify metadata permissions.
notificationCenter.performanceMeaning: A monitored performance metric met its configured threshold condition.
notificationCenter.performanceCause: Connections, running threads, buffer usage, replication lag, or health score may be outside the expected range.
notificationCenter.performanceAction: Compare the measurement and threshold in technical details, then review the same period in Performance and Process Center.
notificationCenter.connectionMeaning: A connection or server-access event was recorded.
notificationCenter.connectionCause: Host/port, TLS, credentials, network access, or server connection limits may be involved.
notificationCenter.connectionAction: Test the connection profile and verify host, port, TLS, and user permissions based on the error code.
notificationCenter.sqlMeaning: An SQL or structured database operation could not be completed by the server/driver.
notificationCenter.sqlCause: SQL syntax, permissions, a missing object, a constraint, timeout, or another engine error may be responsible.
notificationCenter.sqlAction: Review the error code and technical details. Open the related SQL in the editor and verify the target database and user permissions.
notificationCenter.genericMeaning: This record was created by Coreor Database to track an important application or database event.
notificationCenter.genericCause: The cause depends on the source and technical metadata fields.
notificationCenter.genericAction: Use the server, database, code, and timestamp to inspect the related workspace.
notificationCenter.localHistoryNote: This record was written to the local notification history by Coreor Database. SQL/performance notifications are stored in the encrypted workspace vault on this device and remain available here after the toast closes.

security.plaintextDescription: Server profiles and passwords are never stored on disk in plaintext.
security.connectionVaultDescription: Profile metadata and database passwords are encrypted with AES-256-GCM inside connection-vault.
security.workspaceVaultDescription: SQL history, restored query tabs/results, notebooks, activity logs and operational SQL records are encrypted in a separate workspace-vault.
security.deviceKeyDescription: A 256-bit device key is stored in the operating system secure store so daily use does not require the master password.
security.zeroKnowledgeDescription: On a new device, the Vault Password will unlock the key through Argon2id; the server stores ciphertext only.
security.defaultReadOnlyDescription: The new-server form starts in READ ONLY mode by default. It can still be changed per profile.
security.approvalCenterDescription: Manage pending, approved and rejected requests.
security.keyOnFirstConnection: will be created on first connection
security.cloudNotActive: Cloud sync is not active yet; there is no plaintext upload path.
security.autoSnapshotDescription: Stores the table structure in local history before each ALTER TABLE.
security.secondApprovalDescription: Sends DROP and TRUNCATE operations to the approval center.
security.productionAlterDescription: Includes ALTER TABLE operations in the second-approval flow.
security.readOnlyNative: is read-only. This policy is enforced in the native Rust/Tauri database layer in addition to the UI controls.
security.schemaProtectionDescription: ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE and connection write policies.
security.zeroKnowledgeReady: AVK + Argon2id KEK • Remember this device is ready

developer.toolsDescription: Allows opening WebView developer tools with F12 / Ctrl+Shift+I. Disabled by default.
developer.warning: DevTools can display open SQL text, query results, WebView runtime state and some IPC call details. Enable it only on trusted computers and for debugging.
developer.operationsDescription: Migration, backups, prepared lab, comparisons and masking.

account.accountDescription: The account is optional; the local database client remains fully functional without signing in.
account.sessionDescription: Connection profiles, SQL history and local settings are not tied to the account.
account.onlineFeaturesDescription: Cloud sync, team workspaces and shared snippets will be enabled by capability in the future.
account.cloudPrivacy: The Coreor Account API will be connected separately; local database data and connection passwords will not be uploaded automatically.
account.localWorkspaceDescription: Connection and application information stored on this computer.
account.localVaultDescription: Connection profiles are not stored in config.json; they are kept in an encrypted local vault protected by the device key.
account.onlineFeatureNames: Cloud Sync • Team Workspaces • Shared Snippets

unauthorized.message: Your session could not be authenticated.
unauthorized.hint: Sign in again and retry the operation.

sessionInvalid.message: Your session is no longer valid.

userNotAllowed.message: This account is not allowed to access the database workspace.
userNotAllowed.hint: Add the account user ID to the application's access policy.

crossOrigin.message: The request was rejected by the security policy.
crossOrigin.hint: Open the application from its configured origin and retry.

hostNotAllowed.message: Connections to this database host are not allowed.
hostNotAllowed.hint: Add the host to the production database allowlist.

privateHostNotAllowed.message: This private or local-network database target is not allowed.
privateHostNotAllowed.hint: Explicitly add the server to the database host allowlist.

portNotAllowed.message: Connections to this database port are not allowed.
portNotAllowed.hint: Add the port to the server-side allowed-port list.

authenticationFailed.message: The database rejected the supplied credentials.
authenticationFailed.hint: Check the username, password, and host-based user permissions.

hostNotFound.message: The database server address could not be resolved.
hostNotFound.hint: Check the host name and DNS record.

dnsTemporary.message: DNS temporarily could not resolve the database address.

connectionTimeout.message: The database server could not be reached in time.
connectionTimeout.hint: Check that the server is running, the port, firewall rules, and network route.

timeout.hint: Check network access and the connection timeout setting.

connectionRefused.message: The database server refused the connection.
connectionRefused.hint: Check that the service is listening on the configured port and verify firewall rules.

tlsVerification.message: The database TLS certificate could not be verified.
tlsVerification.hint: Check the certificate chain, validity period, and the hostname you are connecting to.

databaseNotFound.message: The selected database was not found or is not accessible to this user.
databaseNotFound.hint: Check the database name and user permissions.

tableNotFound.message: The target table was not found.
tableNotFound.hint: Refresh the schema or table list and retry.

sqlSyntax.message: The database rejected the SQL query because of a syntax error.
sqlSyntax.hint: Check the failing statement and the selected database dialect.

parseError.message: The SQL query contains a syntax error.

uniqueConstraint.message: The operation violates a unique-field constraint.
uniqueConstraint.hint: Check for an existing row with the same unique or primary-key value.

duplicateEntry.message: A row with the same unique value already exists.
duplicateEntry.hint: Check the unique or primary-key value.

readOnly.message: This connection profile is read-only, so the change was blocked.
readOnly.hint: If a write is required, deliberately disable read-only mode in the profile settings.

rateLimited.message: Too many database requests were sent in a short period.

requestTooLarge.message: The submitted data exceeds the allowed request size.
requestTooLarge.hint: Split the file or operation into smaller parts.

blobTooLarge.message: The BLOB data exceeds the allowed size.
blobTooLarge.hint: Use a smaller file or carefully increase the server limit.

transactionNotFound.message: The open transaction can no longer be found.
transactionNotFound.hint: Start the transaction again; it may have been closed by a server restart or timeout.

apiUnreachable.message: The database API could not be reached.
apiUnreachable.hint: Check network connectivity and the application server status.

invalidResponse.message: The database API returned an unexpected response.
invalidResponse.hint: Refresh and retry; if the issue continues, inspect the server logs.

forbidden.message: You do not have the required permission for this database operation.
forbidden.hint: Check the session and server-side access policy.

serverFailure.message: The database operation could not be completed on the server.
serverFailure.hint: Retry; if the issue continues, inspect application and database logs.

generic.message: The database operation could not be completed.

aborted.hint: You can start the operation again.

nativeNoDetail.message: The native database operation failed without driver details.
nativeNoDetail.hint: Retry; if the issue continues, inspect technical details in Notification Center.

unreadableResponse.message: The database API returned an unreadable response.
unreadableResponse.hint: Refresh; if the issue continues, inspect application server logs.
